text: Pass the complete battery and open sled through the open butt. Offer a lighter cap and an interchangeable weighted screw cap below the hand.

The R2 candidate uses radial hook entry, an upward slide to load stops and an indexed quarter-turn keeper. Release with the battery cap removed. Physical fit and strength still require a fitted trial.
Use an integral recessed Choc seat retained by the bought switch clips. Cut post, pin, socket and wire clearance after structural unions and export one closed grip mesh per hand.
